about_the_game:
THE ULTIMATE ENTERTAINMENT

Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to LAST RIDE! The greatest show on Earth, where the adrenaline rush of a demolition derby meets the relentless tension of a battle royale. In a world transformed by centuries of climate catastrophe, our monumental arenas stand as temples of chaos, ready to host clashes where speed, strategy, and destruction reign supreme.

RACING CARS AGAINST CHAOS

Aboard supercharged vehicles, our riders race at full speed in monumental arenas. Crash and pulverise your opponents to the cheers of billions of spectators connected around the world. When your racing car is nothing more than a burning wreck... the battle has truly begun.

Once thrown from their cars, the Riders continue the battle on foot. By collecting debris from the clashes, they can craft improvised weapons and ingenious traps to turn the tide of the match. Here, every second counts; every move can change the course of destiny.

BREATHTAKING ARENAS

Built in the heart of futuristic cities and iconic locations in extreme environments, our arenas are alive, spectacular and unforgiving. They shrink, transform and collapse before your eyes, forcing survivors to battle until only ONE remains!

STARS IN THE EYES OF THE WORLD

LAST RIDE isn't just a competition, it's the biggest show on the planet! Every match is broadcast live on billions of screens, accompanied by colossal bets, extravagant sponsors and staging that transforms each rider into a true global star. Become one of these modern idols, wear your nation's colours and write your own legend. Because only one thing matters: being the last survivor.

SO, SPECTATORS, ARE YOU READY?

The arena lights up, the engines roar and the whole world holds its breath. Now it's up to you to race, destroy and survive. Because in LAST RIDE, there is only one rule: be the last one standing.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: These specs are subject to change during development.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 2060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: These specs are subject to change during development.

short_description: YOU are launched at full speed into the arena, determined to crush your opponents at the wheel of your racing car. But even when your car gives up the ghost, the fight isn't over. You continue the battle on foot until there is only ONE SURVIVOR left!
